title: 🔥 GOD DOES CALL THE QUALIFIED—HE QUALIFIES THE CALLED! 🔥
paragraphs:
🔥 GOD DOES CALL THE QUALIFIED—HE QUALIFIES THE CALLED! 🔥
📖 1 Corinthians 1:27 – "But God chose the foolish things of the world to shame the wise; God chose the weak things of the world to shame the strong."

❓ QUESTION FROM A READER:
"Brother John, I feel like I’m not good enough to serve God. I see preachers, worship leaders, and strong Christians, and I think, ‘I don’t have the knowledge, the skills, or the confidence to do what they do.’ Does God really call someone like me?"
🔥 EXCELLENT QUESTION! Many people feel unworthy, unqualified, or too broken to be used by God. But here’s the TRUTH:
🚨 GOD DOESN’T CHOOSE PERFECT PEOPLE—HE TRANSFORMS ORDINARY, WEAK, AND UNLIKELY PEOPLE INTO MIGHTY WARRIORS FOR HIS KINGDOM!
If you’ve ever felt too weak, too sinful, or too inexperienced, this message is for YOU!

🔥 1. GOD USES THE UNLIKELY!
📖 Exodus 4:10 – "Moses said to the LORD, ‘Pardon your servant, Lord. I have never been eloquent... I am slow of speech and tongue.’"
🔥 Look at the people God used in the Bible:

✔️ MOSES – A stuttering man, afraid to speak, yet God used him to confront Pharaoh and lead an entire nation to freedom.
✔️ GIDEON – A fearful man hiding from his enemies, yet God called him a "mighty warrior" (Judges 6:12).
✔️ DAVID – A young shepherd boy, overlooked by his own family, yet he was chosen to be king of Israel.
✔️ PETER – A fisherman who constantly failed, denied Jesus three times, yet became the bold leader of the early Church.
✔️ PAUL – A persecutor of Christians, yet God transformed him into one of the greatest apostles.
🚨 GOD DOESN’T LOOK AT YOUR PAST—HE LOOKS AT YOUR WILLINGNESS TO OBEY HIM!
💡 Are you willing to say YES, even if you feel unqualified?

🔥 2. GOD EQUIPS THOSE HE CALLS!
📖 2 Corinthians 12:9 – "My grace is sufficient for you, for My power is made perfect in weakness."
🔥 You don’t need to be strong—GOD is strong!

✔️ GOD GIVES WISDOM – If you lack knowledge, He will teach you (James 1:5).
✔️ GOD GIVES BOLDNESS – If you’re afraid, He will fill you with courage (Acts 4:13).
✔️ GOD GIVES STRENGTH – If you feel weak, He will strengthen you (Isaiah 40:29).
✔️ GOD GIVES THE RIGHT WORDS – If you don’t know what to say, He will speak through you (Luke 12:12).
🚨 STOP FOCUSING ON WHAT YOU CAN’T DO AND START TRUSTING WHAT GOD CAN DO THROUGH YOU!
💡 Are you willing to let God equip you for His calling?

🔥 3. THE BIGGEST LIES THAT KEEP PEOPLE FROM SERVING GOD – EXPOSED!
📖 Jeremiah 1:6-7 – "‘Alas, Sovereign LORD,’ I said, ‘I do not know how to speak; I am too young.’ But the LORD said to me, ‘Do not say, "I am too young." You must go to everyone I send you to and say whatever I command you.’"
🔥 Satan wants to keep you from fulfilling God’s purpose. Let’s expose his lies!

❌ LIE #1: "I’m not smart enough."
✔️ TRUTH: God gives wisdom to those who seek Him (Proverbs 2:6).

❌ LIE #2: "I’ve sinned too much—God can’t use me."
✔️ TRUTH: God forgave Paul, Peter, and David. He will forgive and use you too (1 John 1:9).

❌ LIE #3: "I’m too young / too old."
✔️ TRUTH: Jeremiah was young (Jeremiah 1:7), Abraham was old (Genesis 17:17)—God used them both!

❌ LIE #4: "I’m not a preacher or pastor—I have no title."
✔️ TRUTH: You don’t need a title to serve—just a willing heart (Colossians 3:23).
🚨 STOP LISTENING TO SATAN’S LIES AND START WALKING IN GOD’S CALLING!
💡 Will you allow excuses to stop you, or will you step out in faith?

🔥 4. REAL-LIFE TESTIMONY – FROM NOBODY TO GOD’S SERVANT!
A young woman felt unqualified to share the gospel. She thought, "I don’t have a Bible degree, I’m not a pastor, I don’t even know all the verses."

🔥 One day, she realized that all God wanted was her obedience. She started reading the Bible, praying for wisdom, and sharing Jesus with others. Now, she leads Bible studies and has helped many come to Christ!
🚨 SHE DIDN’T START QUALIFIED—GOD QUALIFIED HER AS SHE OBEYED!
💡 WILL YOU LET GOD DO THE SAME WITH YOU?

🔥 FINAL WARNING: GOD IS CALLING YOU—WILL YOU ANSWER?
📖 Isaiah 6:8 – "Then I heard the voice of the Lord saying, ‘Whom shall I send? And who will go for us?’ And I said, ‘Here am I. Send me!’"
🚨 God is calling YOU to serve Him. Will you say YES or will you make excuses?

🔥 WHAT WILL YOU CHOOSE?
❌ Keep doubting yourself and miss your calling?
✔️ Step out in faith and let God use you mightily?
🚨 CHOOSE NOW—BECAUSE GOD IS WAITING FOR YOUR YES!

🙏 PRAYER TO SURRENDER TO GOD’S CALLING
"Lord, I surrender my fears, my doubts, and my weaknesses to You. I know that You don’t call the qualified, but You qualify those You call. Use me for Your glory. Strengthen me, guide me, and equip me to serve You. In Jesus’ name, AMEN!"
